note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; relations are drawn only as supplied and the replay result is supplied, never inferred.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Four events joined by supplied sequence links; the tracer runs with every event, then event 2 slides out of the model and, as supplied, the replay stops at the gap (the loss is not reached).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a five-event storeroom board with one link supplied as causal, one disputed, an alternative tied to its link and an extra plain relation; event 3 is removed and, as supplied, a bypass carries the replay to the loss; the tracer detours through the alternative.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Six events with near-maximum labels and times, two long loss descriptions, two long alternatives, link captions, an extra relationship, long relation captions and a full traversal order.

events.label: Delivery crate left partly blocking the main customer aisle of the shop overnight
Motorised floor-cleaning trolley makes contact with the delivery crate at the corner
Freestanding shelf unit standing directly behind the crate is jolted sideways
Ceramic display stand next to the shelf unit begins to wobble on its uneven feet
Glass display cover resting on the stand slides slowly towards the front edge
Display cover falls against the tall pedestal holding the hand-painted vase

causalLinks.label: causal as stated in Party A’s written account of events
disputed by Party B in its reply to the written account

alternatives.label: A customer leaning heavily on the display stand shortly before the incident
Vibration from a delivery lorry unloading at the rear door of the shop

losses.label: Hand-painted ceramic vase cracked from rim to base (hypothetical value 1,200 units)
Glazed water jug chipped along its lip and handle (hypothetical value 300 units)

relationships.label: put forward by Party B as another account of the same moment

relationLabels.relation: related as described by the parties
relationLabels.sequence: follows in the order supplied by Party A
relationLabels.causal: causal link as supplied by the proposing party
relationLabels.disputed: disputed by the other party in its reply
relationLabels.without: the model without event 4, exactly as supplied by Party A

presets.name: baseline-es
presets.description: Baseline in Spanish (built-in labels and fictional content).
